description_en: Queries the details of a specified Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
description_zh: 查询指定网络型负载均衡实例的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun nlb get-load-balancer-attribute --load-balancer-id nlb-83ckzc8d4xlp8o0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetLoadBalancerAttribute

parameters.help_en: The Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会查询实例的配置信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the value of RequestId as ClientToken. The value of RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

AddressIpVersion.description_en:
The protocol version. Valid values:

ipv4: IPv4.
DualStack: dual stack
AddressIpVersion.description_zh:
协议版本。取值：

ipv4：IPv4类型。
DualStack：双栈类型

AddressType.description_en:
The IPv4 network address type of the NLB instance. Valid values:
Internet: The load balancing instance has a public IP address. The DNS domain name is resolved to the public IP address. Therefore, the instance can be accessed over the Internet.
Intranet: The load balancing instance has only a private IP address. The DNS domain name is resolved to the private IP address. Therefore, the instance can be accessed only within the internal network of the VPC where the load balancing instance is deployed
AddressType.description_zh:
NLB实例的IPv4网络地址类型。取值：
Internet：公网。负载均衡具有公网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到公网IP，因此可以在公网环境访问。
Intranet：私网。负载均衡只有私网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到私网IP，因此只能被负载均衡所在VPC的内网环境访问

BandwidthPackageId.description_en: The ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance associated with the Internet-facing NLB instance
BandwidthPackageId.description_zh: 公网类型实例关联的共享带宽包ID

Cps.description_en:
The maximum number of new connections per second that the NLB instance can process per zone (VIP). Valid values: 0 to 1000000.

0 indicates that no limit is imposed
Cps.description_zh:
NLB实例在每个可用区（VIP）处理的每秒新建连接限速值。取值范围：0~1000000。

0表示不限速

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource was created. The time is displayed in UTC in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format
CreateTime.description_zh: 资源创建时间，使用格林威治时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`

CrossZoneEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether cross-zone is enabled for the NLB instance. Valid values:
true: enabled.
false: disabled
CrossZoneEnabled.description_zh:
NLB实例是否开启跨可用区。取值：
true：开启。
false：关闭

DNSName.description_en: The domain name of the NLB instance

Enabled.description_en:
The deletion protection status. Valid values:

true: enabled.
false: disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
删除保护状态，取值：

true：开启状态。
false：关闭状态

EnabledTime.description_en: The time when deletion protection was enabled. The time is displayed in UTC in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format
EnabledTime.description_zh: 删除保护开启时间，使用格林威治时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`

Reason.description_en: The reason for changing the deletion protection status. The reason must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The reason must start with a letter or a Chinese character
Reason.description_zh: 更改删除保护状态的原因。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

Ipv6AddressType.description_en:
The IPv6 address type of the NLB instance. Valid values:
Internet: The load balancing instance has a public IP address. The DNS domain name is resolved to the public IP address. Therefore, the instance can be accessed over the Internet.
Intranet: The load balancing instance has only a private IP address. The DNS domain name is resolved to the private IP address. Therefore, the instance can be accessed only within the internal network of the VPC where the load balancing instance is deployed
Ipv6AddressType.description_zh:
NLB实例的IPv6地址类型。取值：
Internet：负载均衡具有公网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到公网IP，因此可以在公网环境访问。
Intranet：负载均衡只有私网IP地址，DNS域名被解析到私网IP，因此只能被负载均衡所在VPC的内网环境访问

LoadBalancerBillingConfig.description_en: The billing configuration of the load balancing instance
LoadBalancerBillingConfig.description_zh: 负载均衡实例计费配置

PayType.description_en:
The billing type of the NLB instance.
Only PostPay is returned, which indicates the pay-as-you-go billing method
PayType.description_zh:
NLB实例的计费类型。
仅取值PostPay：表示按量计费

LoadBalancerBusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the NLB instance. Valid values:
Abnormal: The NLB instance is in an abnormal state.
Normal: The NLB instance is in a normal state
LoadBalancerBusinessStatus.description_zh:
NLB的业务状态。取值：
Abnormal：异常状态。
Normal：正常状态

LoadBalancerName.description_en:
The name of the NLB instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character
LoadBalancerName.description_zh:
NLB实例名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

LoadBalancerStatus.description_en:
The NLB instance status. Valid values:
Inactive: The NLB instance is stopped. The listeners of the instance no longer forward traffic.
Active: The NLB instance is running.
Provisioning: The NLB instance is being created.
Configuring: The NLB instance is being reconfigured (Upgrade/Downgrade).
CreateFailed: The NLB instance failed to be created. In this case, no fees are incurred, and the instance can only be deleted
LoadBalancerStatus.description_zh:
NLB实例状态。取值：
Inactive：已停止，表示实例监听不会再转发流量。
Active：运行中。
Provisioning：创建中。
Configuring：变配中。
CreateFailed：创建失败，此时不会产生费用，实例只能被删除

LoadBalancerType.description_en: The load balancing type. Only network is returned, which indicates Network Load Balancer (NLB)
LoadBalancerType.description_zh: 负载均衡类型。仅取值：network，表示网络型负载均衡

EnabledTime.description_en: The time when modification protection was enabled. The time is displayed in UTC in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format
EnabledTime.description_zh: 修改保护时间，使用格林威治时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`

Reason.description_en:
The reason for enabling modification protection. The reason must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The reason must start with a letter or a Chinese character.

This parameter is valid and required only when Status is set to ConsoleProtection
Reason.description_zh:
输入开启修改保护的原因。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

仅在修改保护配置的Status为ConsoleProtection有效且合法

Status.description_en:
The modification protection status of the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance. Valid values:

NonProtection: Modification protection is disabled. You cannot specify the Reason parameter. If the Reason parameter is specified, the value is cleared.
ConsoleProtection: Console modification protection is enabled. You can specify the Reason parameter.

If the value is ConsoleProtection, you cannot modify the instance configuration in the load balancing console, but you can modify the instance configuration by invoking API operations
Status.description_zh:
网络型负载均衡修改保护状态。取值：

NonProtection：不保护，表示不允许传入修改保护配置的Reason字段。如果配置了Reason，则清空其配置信息。
ConsoleProtection：控制台修改保护，此时允许传入修改保护配置的Reason字段。

当取值为ConsoleProtection，即开启修改保护后，用户不能通过负载均衡控制台修改实例配置，但可以通过调用API修改实例配置

OperationLocks.description_en: The lock state list of the NLB instance. This parameter is returned only when `LoadBalancerBussinessStatus` is Abnormal
OperationLocks.description_zh: NLB实例处于锁定状态列表。在`LoadBalancerBussinessStatus`为Abnormal（异常状态）时才返回当前参数

items.description_en: The lock state list of the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance. This parameter is returned only when `LoadBalancerBussinessStatus` is Abnormal

ResidualLocked: The instance is locked due to residual resources

锁定的类型。取值 ：
SecurityLocked：安全锁定。
RelatedResourceLocked：关联锁定。
FinancialLocked：欠费锁定。
ResidualLocked：残留锁定

OperationLocks.title_zh: 实例处于锁定状态列表

Healthy：健康。

PublicIPv4Address.title_zh: 公网ip地址：仅Get的时候有值

Status.description_en:
The zone status. Valid values:

Active: enabled.
Stopped: stopped. This status can be set only through the CADT disaster recovery management service invocation.
Shifted: DNS manually removed. You can call the [CancelShiftLoadBalancerZones]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412000.html） operation to restore the DNS of the zone.
AutoShifted: DNS automatically removed. When a zone encounters an exception, the system automatically removes the IP address of the abnormal zone to ensure that you can access services normally through the NLB domain name. The IP address is automatically restored when the zone recovers. No manual operation is required.
Starting: starting. This status can be set only through the CADT disaster recovery management service invocation.
Stopping: stopping. This status can be set only through the CADT disaster recovery management service invocation
Status.description_zh:
可用区状态。取值：

Active：启动。
Stopped：已停止。该状态仅支持通过CADT容灾管理服务调用实现。
Shifted：DNS已手动摘除。可通过[CancelShiftLoadBalancerZones]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2412000.html）接口进行可用区DNS恢复。
AutoShifted : DNS已自动摘除。当可用区出现异常等特殊情况时，系统会自动摘除异常可用区IP，以确保您通过NLB域名访问时可以正常访问服务。当可用区恢复正常时会自动加回，无需手动操作。
Starting：启动中。该状态仅支持通过CADT容灾管理服务调用实现。
Stopping：停止中。该状态仅支持通过CADT容灾管理服务调用实现

VSwitchId.description_en: The vSwitch in the zone. Each zone uses one vSwitch and one subnet by default
VSwitchId.description_zh: 可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区默认使用一台交换机和一个子网

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID. You can call the [DescribeZones]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443890.html） operation to query the most recent zone list
ZoneId.description_zh: 可用区ID，您可以通过调用[DescribeZones]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443890.html）接口获取
